item.address: 26A/171 Gloucester Street, The Rocks NSW 2000, NSW 2000
item.description:
Set within one of Sydney's most exclusive residential buildings, this sophisticated single-level apartment offers exceptional scale, privacy and harbour-side elegance.

Occupying almost half a floor, the residence provides approximately 280sqm of internal living, with three car spaces and storage bringing the total area to approximately 338sqm. A rare 26-metre north-facing frontage fills the interiors with natural light, while additional east and west aspects capture harbour, Harbour Bridge and city outlooks.

Designed for effortless living and entertaining, the apartment features expansive living and dining areas, a designer Miele kitchen, three oversized bedrooms and a palatial master suite with walk-through robes and marble ensuite.

Key Features

-	Approximately 280sqm internal; 338sqm total including parking and storage 
-	Single-level residence occupying almost half a floor 
-	Rare 26-metre north-facing frontage 
-	Harbour, Harbour Bridge and city outlooks 
-	Expansive open-plan living and dining with floor-to-ceiling glass 
-	Formal and informal living zones 
-	North-facing balcony ideal for entertaining 
-	Designer kitchen with Miele appliances, stone benchtops and bespoke cabinetry 
-	Three oversized bedrooms with custom joinery 
-	Master suite with walk-through robes and marble ensuite 
-	2.5 bathrooms, including guest powder room 
-	Three secure car spaces plus large private storage room 
-	24-hour concierge, indoor pool, gym, meeting room and rooftop terrace 
-	Prestigious Sydney location moments from Circular Quay, Barangaroo and the CBD 

All figures are approximate.

Available for private viewing by appointment only.

In conjunction with Francis Fusco of Ray White Residential Sydney CBD.
